comments.content: [medium] `CopyOutAddress` dereferences `pSockaddr` with no null check. If any caller can pass in a null pointer (e.g., error paths coming back from native interop), this will AV. Either add a guard (`if (pSockaddr is null) return null;`) or document/enforce non-null at the call site.

[medium] Casting `address` to `SOCKADDR*` weakens the type-safety assumptions here. Please verify that `source` is always aligned for `SOCKADDR` and that the underlying blob holds at least `sizeof(SOCKADDR)` (or the actual sockaddr length) at this offset; otherwise misaligned access or an AV is possible in this unsafe code. If `SocketAddress.CopyOutAddress` only needs an untyped pointer, consider keeping it as `byte*`/`void*` and letting `CopyOutAddress` do any required casting itself based on the actual `sa_family`/length.
[low] Consider making the ordering expectation for `CopyOutAddress` explicit in a test.
[low] Please check whether `address` needs an explicit fallback when the optional value is absent.
